1.explanation: This code mounts a Carbon React <Dropdown> that replicates the DAP/Axe errors from the bug report.  By giving the dropdown an id of “carbon-dropdown-example,” Carbon’s ListBoxField adds aria-controls/aria-owns attributes pointing at “carbon-dropdown-example__menu” even when the menu DOM isn’t present (closed state).  It also wraps the Field in a <div role="listbox"> with no option children, triggering the “role must contain particular children” violation.  Running an accessibility scan on the closed dropdown reproduces the two reported violations.
1.bug_scenario:
In the example page we render a Carbon React with titleText, helperText and a visible label “Dropdown menu options.” When the dropdown is closed, the generated DOM looks like this:
…
Two accessibility violations are flagged by DAP/Axe: 1. “ARIA attributes must conform to valid values.” The closed
points aria-controls/aria-owns at an ID that does not exist in the DOM (the menu isn’t rendered until open). 2. “Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children.” The wrapper
has no child elements with role="option", so it fails the rule that a listbox must contain listbox options.
